Choose images or share them to FixMyShot from another app. Select a destination or ratio, review the preview and export new copies. PNG is the default. Lossless WebP is also available. Settings can apply to the whole batch or only the selected image. On Android 10 or later, copies are saved in Pictures/FixMyShot. Older versions ask for a folder. Select saved images in the results to share them. If a previous export needs review, check its results before starting another.

Images are processed on your device. FixMyShot has no network permission, account or analytics. Original files are read only. Identifying metadata is removed from new copies. Private working copies may remain until you discard the session, reopen the app for age-based cleanup, clear app data or uninstall. External image providers may use the network independently.
